home.tagline: Aussie vibes, seaside sips & all-day brunch, right on Port de Badalona.

about.title: About Us
about.text: Avalon Cafe is a cozy, Australian-style brunch spot on the seafront in Badalona. We serve specialty coffee, fresh juices, and all-day brunch in a relaxed, friendly space — perfect for a slow morning or a catch-up with friends.

feast.title: The Big Avalon Feast
feast.description: We create a warm lunch or dinner feast for you, custom to your tastes.
feast.priceNote: 20€ per person — includes proteins, pasta or rice, and salads, all delivered hot.

delivery.note1: All orders come with a bike delivery fee ranging from 15–25€. Orders over 300€ get free delivery.
delivery.note3: All food is made fresh on the day, in-house.
